comments.body:
@pcbeingused333 - How was the issue discovered? 
thanks for contributing

Found by reading the provider option converters side by side: the Mistral, Z.ai and other converters map `LlmOptions.maxTokens`, while `OllamaOptionsConverter` did not, so a configured limit was dropped for Ollama. It was not from a runtime bug report, and the change has only been checked with the unit tests in `OllamaOptionsConverterTest` (not against a live Ollama server). Happy to adjust if you'd rather map it differently.

(Drafted with the assistance of an AI coding agent.)
